title: Dark Chocolate, Almond and Cherry Christmas Cake
ldName: Dark chocolate, almond and cherry Christmas cake
ldIngredientsRaw: 5 tbsp of coconut flour, (available from most health food shops)
100g of dark chocolate, cut into small chunks
ldInstructionsRaw: In a bowl, add the almond flour, coconut flour, cherries, chocolate, salt, baking soda and the spices and mix well
In a separate bowl, mix together the coconut oil, rum, maple syrup, eggs and vanilla and add to the dry ingredients. Mix well
Grease two 5 inch spring form pans and divide the mixture between them. Bake for 40 minutes
Whilst the cake is cooking, make the icing by mixing together the yoghurt, maple syrup and vanilla

When the cakes are cooked and completely cooled, add some of the icing to the top of one and put the 
other cake on top and add the rest of the icing. Add some extra cherries
